parameters.content:
## 1. Every weekday morning
Finds customers who have not ordered for a while and new prospects worth a first email.
Each account is reserved **once per quiet period**, so running twice never drafts twice.

## 2. Draft each email
Demo: an **offline template** (no AI, no API key).
Real use: set LLM_PROVIDER to openai, anthropic or ollama and the AI writes the draft.
If the AI call fails, that account is marked and an alert email names it.

## 3. Nothing is sent here
Drafts wait in the approval queue.
The sales manager gets one email with a link to review them.
